title: model catalog: add capability flags and pricing/limits to listing endpoints
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add first-class capability fields and pricing/limits metadata to the model catalog listing endpoints to power better client-side filtering, routing decisions, and pricing estimates. This PR extends the model listing API with stable flags (openai_compatible, streaming_supported, function_calling, structured_output) and adds per-model pricing and concurrency/throughput limits. The change is backwards compatible: existing clients get the previous fields unchanged and new fields are optional.

What changed: Implemented new fields in the /v1/models and /v1/models/{id} responses, added SQL migration for capability columns, updated the OpenAI compatibility translator to surface compatibility flags, extended SDK typings and docs, and added tests + e2e coverage. Also added a small helper in response_formatter to keep responses consistent across hosted and dedicated endpoints.

API contract (examples): the listing now returns for each model: capabilities: ["streaming","function_calling","structured_output","openai_compatible"], pricing: {"token_usd_per_1k": "0.0025"}, limits: {"max_concurrency": "64", "max_tokens": "2048"}. All nested objects are represented as top-level stringified maps in SDKs for backward interop; servers may omit keys for models without a specific property.

Migration: SQL migration 20260301_add_capabilities adds capability boolean columns and a pricing metadata jsonb column. Migration is backwards safe and defaults to NULL/false. Rollout plan: gradual feature flag enablement + canary on internal beta orgs before global rollout.

Testing: unit tests for parser/translator, integration tests for API contract, and an e2e that validates SDK deserialization. CI initially failed on a flaky decoder test which was quarantined and fixed in a follow-up commit.

Docs & SDKs: updated docs/api/model_catalog.md, types for TS and Python SDKs with examples of filtering by capabilities and pricing estimation. Added migration notes to the changelog.

Risks & compatibility: No breaking changes expected. OpenAI-compat translation preserves existing shapes; clients that rely on strict contract should update to accept optional pricing/limits fields.

Release notes: Add capability flags and pricing/limits to model catalog endpoints. SDKs updated to expose helpers for capability-based filtering and price estimation.

review_comments: Evan Morales: Can we keep a single enum for capabilities rather than separate booleans to make adding new capabilities easier? Author: opted for array of capability strings internally and boolean columns for fast DB filtering; added comment in migration.
Priya Singh: Pricing shape looks good but we should avoid floats for token unit prices. Author: switched to microcents stored as integer in DB and expose decimal string in API for readability.
Danielle Wu: Please add a migration rollback and ensure the default is safe for older deployments. Author: added safe rollback and null defaults in migration commit.
Evan Morales: CI flaky test observed — thanks for the fix. Approving after CI green.
